versions.changelog:
Initial public release of the Haskell skill guide.

- Provides expert guidance on Haskell development: covers type-driven design, GHC extensions, project setup, common patterns, and recommended styles.
- Includes Cabal-based project templates with modern practices, warnings, and directory layout.
- Documents which GHC extensions to prefer, when to use or avoid, and why.
- Highlights type-safety techniques: newtypes, phantom types, and making illegal states unrepresentable.
- Covers error handling patterns and the ReaderT app pattern for structuring applications.
- Offers concise code examples for common best practices and project setup.
